data.description:
Surfaced September 19, 2026 at 22:45 PDT as a follow-up to the Roi Et labor-force-statistics finding. Activity date: March 11, 2026, as reported in the original review.

Three additional URLQuery reports retrieve the same Roi Et answer table:
• Tmpfiles: 90c67908-e190-4c5b-907a-e22b92a5c709
• Tmpfiles: 32bf11c6-efa1-493c-873c-af30d0443793
• Litterbox: 40f1974f-41e3-4df6-bb86-b18e6f9da61e

The original review had not seen these two temporary file-hosting services mentioned in the previous investigations it checked. This is a scoped novelty observation, not a claim that no one had previously found them.

The contribution is evidence of additional retrieval routes for the same Thai statistics answer table, separate from the URLQuery-to-Pastebin match.
data.summary: Three March 11 URLQuery reports retrieve the same Roi Et answer table through Tmpfiles (two reports) and Litterbox (one). They add temporary file-hosting venues to the task’s evidence;
